run_download_file: run downloading a file from a URL to a local path with retry and exponential backoff
create_httpconnection: create an HTTPConnection instance to manage sync and async HTTP client sessions
test_async_get_bytes: test fetching binary content from a URL asynchronously with retry on transient failures
run_get_json: run fetching and parsing JSON from a URL using the global HTTPConnection instance
review_retry_decorator: review the _sync_retry and _async_retry decorators that add exponential backoff to HTTP methods
